scientific_question: Does a non-learned c_proj rotation chart aligned to the model's natural expansion/head/channel tensor axes capture dense Muon directional motion more efficiently than the rejected fixed random FHT chart?

candidate.hidden_layout: 4 expansion groups x 12 model-head groups x 64 within channels
candidate.rotation_structure: one independent Cayley SO(64) chart per contiguous group plus one shared Cayley group-axis chart
candidate.gains: per hidden and output channel, retained as the radial control

diagnostic.execution: foreground-polled Y400 diagnostic; no training, watchdog, callback, queue, or PRO6

decision_rule.promote_to_smallest_rung_training: Require total capture >= 0.10, total capture / coordinate fraction >= 1.75, and subspace-rotation capture >= 0.08 without a severe layer or phase collapse.
decision_rule.reject: Reject if total capture is below 0.10 or directional capture remains near dimension-matched generic coverage.
